**CDIF**
Definition ==========
Optional XAS data-array variables (energy, i0, itrans, ifluor, irefer, mutrans, mufluor, murefer, normtrans, normfluor, normrefer, chi, chi_re, chi_im, chi_mag, chi_pha, k, r, angle), each a cdi:InstanceVariable / schema:PropertyValue. Not required. The XDI variable propertyID enum is layered on in xasCore; this profile only enforces the base cdifInstanceVariable shape. :inlineOrByReference: ``inline``
